title: Farm, Food, and National Security Act of 2026

claims.claim: SNAP staffing flexibility allowing states to hire contractors during backlogs, surges, or when error rates reach 6 percent
claims.sourceSpan: ``(C) the State experiences an increase in supplemental nutrition assistance program applications.''
claims.note: The magnitude qualifier 'surges' is not in the source; the statutory trigger is ANY increase in SNAP applications, not specifically a surge. The word narrows the trigger's actual breadth. Same qualifier recurs in sections[1].items[0].detail ('when applications surge').
